definition: A neurological condition caused by prolonged or unregulated BCI use in which the user begins experiencing involuntary bleed-over between their own thoughts and residual data patterns in the Diaspora. Symptoms include false memories, phantom sensory input, and difficulty distinguishing personal cognition from cached network data.
origin: Medical terminology; coined by Helix Biosystems neurologists but adopted broadly as street slang
usage: Medical professionals, Wire Heads, BCI technicians; commonly referenced in Tier 1-2 clinics
example: Three years on an unshielded node and she had full Dendrite Drift — kept reciting strangers' grocery lists like they were her own memories.
